entries.title: Android build credentials and runtime skeleton
entries.description: Adds fork-specific API credentials from local.properties and the Kotlin/tele runtime skeleton (TeleConfig, TeleHooks, tele.db) that later Android changes build on. This is Android-only build and storage foundation.

entries.title: Android packaging, branding and launcher icons
desktop: rename the app to tele
call the app tele everywhere
new tele app and tray icons
entries.description: Renames the app and fork packages, disables stock Google services, overrides user-visible app names, and ships the Android adaptive launcher, notification and settings icons. The packaging, string overrides and generated icon assets are Android-specific work; the naming and icon feature follows the desktop.

entries.title: Native tele settings, navigation and search
desktop: add a tele section to the settings
group and search tele settings
regroup tele settings pages
collapsible sub-toggles in tele settings
trim settings descriptions
entries.description: Builds the Android tele settings tree: section pages, grouped rows, collapsible sub-options, and stock settings-search integration that opens and highlights the matching row. Includes Android-side fixes for search results and rows; the settings architecture is native Android work around the desktop settings feature.

entries.title: Local names and aliases with shared native editors
desktop: name people only for you
link usernames to profiles locally
entries.description: Adds Android editors for per-account local names and usernames: themed inline fields with delete, management screens in tele settings, and one shared alias dialog used by chat and profile menus. The feature follows desktop local names and aliases; the editor flow is native Android.

entries.title: Retained deleted messages, edit history and saved drafts
desktop: keep deleted messages
keep messages you delete yourself
keep the edit history of messages
show edit history as a chat
keep drafts on this device
save drafts for later
entries.description: Stores kept deleted messages, message edits and draft snapshots in tele.db and adds native screens for drafts and deleted messages. The desktop retention and draft features are reimplemented for Android storage and UI; the Android design is substantial, but the feature concept is not claimed as original.

entries.title: Public tele server, Argon2 and crash bridge
desktop: apply verification and marks from the tele server
show checkmarks and custom verification everywhere
clear server data and explain custom verifications
usernames from the tele server
send crash reports to the tele server
entries.description: Adds the Android client for the public tele server: hashed badge feed, Argon2 helper, server usernames, badge rendering hooks, refresh and clear, and the crash-report upload bridge. It only downloads public data and sends no account data, matching the desktop server feature.

entries.title: Android updater, release notes and local tele chat
desktop: update from the tele github releases
show what's new in tele after an update
show new settings after an update
browse every tele version's changes
what's new as a settings page with live toggles
entries.description: Implements the Android in-app updater (APK feed, SHA-256, resume and retry), a local "tele" changelog chat, per-version history and live new-settings toggles. The update flow is Android-specific; the release-notes and what's-new behavior follows the desktop.

entries.title: Message shots and render pipeline
desktop: save messages as a picture
scale shots up to 4x and show your messages as incoming
choose what shots show
show skipped messages in shots
entries.description: Renders selected messages into a bitmap on Android with 1x-4x scale, incoming-style own messages, configurable visibility and skipped-message markers; fixes sender and badge rendering and normalizes docked-shot sending. The rendering code is Android-native work around the desktop shot feature.

entries.title: Notification center, presence and service notices
desktop: notify when people come online
notification centre
rate-limit notices for slowmode and download throttling
mentions and replies in the notification centre
reply and mention badges in the notification centre
notification centre shows whole entries
copied values in the notification centre
server notices
entries.description: Adds the on-device notification center and its Android integrations: tgnet flood-wait hook, presence notifications, mention and reply entries, badges, full entries, copied-value logging, tele toasts and server notices. The subsystem is ported, with the JNI hook and Android UI written here.

entries.title: Diagnostics, MTProto tools and memory reports
desktop: capture and inspect mtproto
add the mtproto console
send crash reports to the tele server
send crash reports without a dump
report freezes
entries.description: Adds Android diagnostics: memory data in crash reports, OOM heap snapshots, Java-side MTProto capture and inspection, a schema-driven MTProto console, no-dump and freeze reports, and foreground-only freeze gating. The Android tooling and crash surfaces are native work; capture and console behavior follows the desktop.

entries.title: Wallet engine Android integration
desktop: take wallet-engine from gettele/money for private keys
import wallets from private keys
copy secret words without waiting
turn on the wallet before telegram does
entries.description: Builds the Android wallet engine with private-key support, key rotation and backup, import and recovery screens, pasted-word handling and phrase-sheet scrolling. The engine integration and NDK bridge are Android work built on the desktop wallet-engine feature.

entries.title: Android scripting host and native scripting UIs
desktop: scripting prototype
let scripts give their menu items icons
entries.description: Adds the QuickJS-ng JNI host, per-account script runtimes, grants and sandboxing, and native Android surfaces for menus, links, notifications, shared files, compose, player, calls, message actions, script text and logs. The host and UI are Android-native implementations of the desktop scripting prototype.

entries.title: Cross-cutting fork security boundaries
entries.description: Hardens fork boundaries that stock Android does not cover: per-account script isolation and approvals, pending-reply ownership, streamer-mode secret windows, last-seen restoration, local-password recovery ownership, bounded regex, notice and update paths, and the published QuickJS and widget-engine memory-safety fixes in both vendored engines. Also carries the Telegram Desktop 7.4.4 widget hardening: the widget-sandbox and twidget pins, host-call argument caps, HTML/CSS/SVG and renderer limits, and PNG bit-depth validation. Bounds the wallet engine's dictionary parsing and refuses wallet contract initialization data with more than 16 libraries, following Telegram Desktop 7.4.4.

entries.title: Docked media composer
desktop: attach media above the field (docked media)
caption docked media and bring it to parity with the send box
entries.description: Implements the Android media composer above the message field: docked photos, video, documents, shots and captioned stickers, per-chat and per-topic drafts, reordering, spoiler previews, drag animation, removal and send integration. The composer is a substantial native Android implementation of the desktop docked-media feature.

entries.title: Round video recording controls
entries.description: Android round-video camera preview, manual start and zoom controls.

entries.title: Wide-screen folder sidebar
desktop: compact icon-only folders
entries.description: Adds an optional vertical folder bar for tablets and unfolded phones. The native Android view reuses the stock folder controller for selection, locking and swipes, mirrors unread counters, and leaves phone and forwarding layouts unchanged.

entries.title: Photo shape padding
desktop: pad extreme image shapes for photo sending
entries.description: Stock Android turns a photo whose aspect ratio is wider than 10:1 into a file. The option instead pads the upload bitmap with the smallest black margins that reach Telegram's accepted shape, after stock's own EXIF rotation, HD sizing and JPEG quality. The original file on disk is untouched and sending as a file stays an unpadded file; the composer preview shows the padded shape.

entries.title: Per-media software volumes
desktop: separate music, video, voice and round video volumes
entries.description: Android has a single system volume stream, so the desktop's four saved volumes become four software gain levels (music, video, voice messages, round videos) applied inside the players. A value never raises stock's own volume, so system volume keys, mute, ducking and cast keep working, and 100% is exactly stock. Levels live in TeleConfig, are exported with settings and apply to the live player immediately. An optional switch also puts a volume button in the three players that carries the level: the video viewer's title bar next to its quality and speed controls, the full music player next to its speed control, and the chat mini-player (beside the close button for music, beside the speed control for voice and round videos). Each button opens the same kind of slider popup the stock speed control uses and writes the level of the media type it is currently playing.

entries.title: Composer editing helpers
desktop: optional composer editing helpers
entries.description: Three independent field helpers behind off-by-default switches: wrapping a selection in quotes, brackets, bold markers or backticks (and unwrapping it), auto-closing bracket and quote pairs with step-over and one-step pair deletion, and keeping a line's indentation on a new line. Auto-closing also completes a code block: three backticks at the end of a line add the blank body and the closing fence, with the cursor placed inside, unless the cursor is already inside an open fence. A single backtick never pairs on its own, matching the desktop, where it only wraps a selection. Implemented once in EditTextBoldCursor, so chats, topics, replies, edits and captions share it; every operation is one undo step and inserts plain text only. A paren that continues a typed emoticon like :-( stays literal instead of auto-closing.

entries.title: Chat picture editor
entries.description: One sheet turns chat messages into pictures. It opens from a system screenshot of a chat (Android 14+ screen capture callback, or the gallery observer on older versions when photo access is already granted) and, replacing the Shot screen, from the message menu and the selection bar; it survives the chat pausing. Messages are hidden by swiping left, text is cut under spoiler dust through the stock text selection, a chat theme and day/night are previewed through the sheet's own resources provider without touching the chat (day/night opens in a circle from the switch), names stay as in contacts, use people's own names, read "Someone" or are renamed for this picture only, the badges next to names can be dropped, the Shot options (parts, incoming, dates, skipped, background, scale) sit behind Options, and an optional tele footer is drawn. A shot stays one picture while it fits in memory and otherwise splits into screen-tall pictures like a screenshot does; the pictures go through the stock share sheet as an album with a comment, or are copied, saved, shared or sent to the open chat. View-once, paid and protected messages are left out.

entries.title: Pin Saved Messages past the limit
entries.description: An always-on Android original: Saved Messages can be pinned in the main chat list past the pinned-chats limit. DialogsActivity skips the limit alert for a Saved-Messages-only pin selection and keeps the avatar-preview Pin item; when the client limit is full, LocalPins pins the self dialog locally even with its own switch off, restores that pin after restart, converts a server PINNED_* rejection for it, and drops it once the server pins the chat. Other chats and folder-tab pins keep stock limits.

entries.title: Material You themes and custom palettes
entries.description: An off-by-default Android 12+ original, built on Google's Material 3 color utilities: three bundled at-theme assets (Material Light, Material Dark, Material AMOLED) whose color tokens are resolved locally from a seed. The seed comes from the system wallpaper palette (re-read and re-applied on resume), a color picked in the stock color picker or a photo quantized on the device with QuantizerCelebi and Score, which keeps only the seed, stores nothing from the photo and uploads nothing. The chat background is flat from the same palette, true black in AMOLED. The switch saves the previous day and night themes, the auto-night rule and the wallpaper (the pre-Material wallpaper is only kept for that restore), puts Material into the stock day and night slots so Telegram's day/night and auto-night keep driving, and restores all of it when switched off; a wallpaper chosen while Material is active is kept and survives restarts, and per-chat wallpapers keep their priority. While enabled, Material has its own preview tile in the stock chat-settings appearance picker: choosing it turns the switch on, and choosing any other theme there or in browse themes turns Material off. The Material themes stay hidden in the stock theme pickers while the switch is off.

entries.title: Customizable bottom navigation bar
entries.description: An off-by-default Android original: the main tab bar becomes a list of up to six slots. The stock pages (Chats, Contacts, Calls, Settings, Profile) can be reordered and hidden, Chats stays first, and Calls and Settings are separate pages. Saved Messages or any chat can be added as a shortcut that shows that chat's avatar, opens it fullscreen and carries its unread count, with muted chats staying silent. Any non-chat slot can take any of the stock animated tab icons and keeps their fill animation. The Edit tabs screen, opened from a row under the settings toggle and from the bar's long-press menus, drags to reorder, adds and removes slots, picks icons, sets which tabs show labels (all, selected only or icons only) and resets to defaults. Every change rebuilds the bar live and keeps the selected tab; with the switch off the stock bar is untouched.

entries.title: Chat list keeps old dialogs
entries.description: Fixes a stock Android chat-list bug: chats from an older period could vanish from All chats and every folder. Dialog pagination used the oldest message of a loaded page as the getDialogs offset, including old pinned top messages, so everything between that date and the real page bottom was never fetched; dialogsLoadedTillDate was poisoned the same way and sortDialogs then hid already-loaded old chats. The offset now uses the oldest non-pinned top message per dialog, tracked separately for channels, and the till-date filter skips pinned dialogs and tracks channels separately. The same guards apply to the dialogs reset and migration paths.

entries.title: Desktop tele 29 parity
entries.description: The combined desktop tele 29 bundle was split into one patch per feature.
entries.reason: Pure desktop ports no longer need a cross-cutting Android identity; substantial adaptations use A026–A028.

entries.title: Matching blockquotes in reply headers
desktop: show matching blockquotes as reply quotes
entries.description: A display-only Android adaptation of the desktop rich-quote feature: when a reply and the ordinary text message it answers begin with exactly the same raw blockquote text and inline entities, the source quote is shown in the reply header with existing quote chrome and inline formatting. Tapping the header highlights source offset 0. Existing server/manual quotes always win; rich messages, media, albums, translations and mismatched or duplicate quotes stay stock.

entries.title: Incoming Money transfer notices
desktop: incoming money transfer notifications and badge
entries.description: Tracks inbound wallet transactions per account with a bounded, persisted seen-id baseline and a ten-minute fallback poll. New incoming transfers optionally create entries in tele's notification center and add a +N count next to Money in the chat menu until the wallet is opened. Both switches default off, NO_MONEY disables the tracker, and Telegram unread counters are untouched.

entries.title: Media download route fallback
desktop: stalled media downloads fall back to the regular connection
entries.description: A native tgnet adaptation of the desktop media-route fix. After two pre-data connect timeouts on one download slot, the socket latches onto the regular DC route and switches address, temporary auth key, salt, init state and session together. Request tokens, chunk offsets and callbacks stay unchanged; sibling slots, CDN, uploads, established transfers and cached media keys/salts are left alone.
